_about: Scientific data library, domain environment: the universal columns of the game's body/data/environment.json tables, written by scripts/split_data.py. Same columns/rows schema as the game's tables. `id` is stable (see README); `source` holds source keys from sources.json ('; ' separated) or 'open'. Mark is the review state of these columns. A null in a column the engine's data/*.json holds by the same id means the engine file is the home of that value.

exposure.title: Where a character is: the exposure the body reads
exposure.source: WBGT estimated from air temperature, humidity and sun (the Australian Bureau of Meteorology approximation is the usual shortcut; shade and wind lower it); the mosquito and water multipliers are MEDICINE.md hygiene rows placed by terrain; the rest are the keeper's placeholders.
